```{r}
# run twice 
library(Matrix)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("wakefulness_to_R.csv") %>%
 filter(is_peak %in% c(1),
        sov %in% c("wnbeg", "wnmid1", "wnmid2", "wnmid3", "wnend"),
        cond %in% c("Bl0T1", "Bl0T2"))

data$sov <- as.factor(data$sov)
data$component <- as.factor(data$component)
data$is_peak <- as.factor(data$is_peak)
data$cond <- factor(data$cond,     levels = c("Bl0T1", "Bl0T2", "Bl0T3", "Bl0T4"),      ordered = TRUE)
data$sov <- factor(data$sov,  levels = c("wnbeg", "wnmid1", "wnmid2", "wnmid3", "wnend"), ordered = TRUE)

N100_data <- subset(data, component == "N100")
P2_data <- subset(data, component == "P2")
N350_data <- subset(data, component == "N350")
```

```{r}
# Function to analyze each component
analyze_component <- function(comp_data, comp_name) {
  # Fit all three models
  null_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ 1 + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  main_effects_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov + cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  interaction_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov * cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  
  # Test for main effects
  sov_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  sov_comparison <- anova(null_model, sov_model)
  
  cond_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  cond_comparison <- anova(null_model, cond_model)
  
  # Perform nested model comparisons
  null_vs_main <- anova(null_model, main_effects_model)
  main_vs_interaction <- anova(main_effects_model, interaction_model)
  null_vs_interaction <- anova(null_model, interaction_model)
  
  # Get estimated marginal means
  emm_sov <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov)
  emm_cond <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ cond)
  emm_interaction <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov * cond)
  emm_sov_df <- as.data.frame(emm_sov)
  emm_cond_df <- as.data.frame(emm_cond)
  emm_interaction_df <- as.data.frame(emm_interaction)

  # Plot for main effect of SOV
  p1 <- ggplot(emm_sov_df, aes(x = sov, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "SOV", y = "Amplitude", title = "Main Effect of SOV") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Plot for main effect of Cond
  p2 <- ggplot(emm_cond_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Cond", y = "Amplitude", title = "Main Effect of Cond") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Plot for interaction
  p3 <- ggplot(emm_interaction_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, color = sov, group = sov)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", title = "SOV x Condition Interaction") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Display plots
  plots <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 2)
  
  if(null_vs_interaction$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.05) {
    return(list(
      component = comp_name,
      null_vs_main = null_vs_main,
      main_vs_interaction = main_vs_interaction,
      null_vs_interaction = null_vs_interaction,
      sov_effect = sov_comparison,
      cond_effect = cond_comparison,
      interaction_model_summary = summary(interaction_model),
      interaction_model = interaction_model,
      plots = plots
    ))
  } else {
    return(list(
      component = comp_name,
      null_vs_main = null_vs_main,
      main_vs_interaction = main_vs_interaction,
      null_vs_interaction = null_vs_interaction,
      message = "Null model is not significantly different from interaction model",
      plots = plots
    ))
  }
}

# Print results for each component
print_results <- function(results) {
  cat("\n__Results for", results$component, ":__\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  cat("\n__Model Comparison (Null vs Full):__\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  print(results$model_comparison)
  cat("\nNull vs Main Effects Model:\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  print(results$null_vs_main)
  cat("\nMain Effects vs Interaction Model:\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  print(results$main_vs_interaction)
  cat("\nNull vs Interaction Model:\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  print(results$null_vs_interaction)
  
  if(!is.null(results$message)) {
    cat("\n", results$message, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n__Main effect of SOV:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(results$sov_effect)
    cat("\n__Main effect of Condition:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(results$cond_effect)
    cat("\n__Full model summary:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(results$interaction_model_summary)
    
    # Add emmeans analyses
    cat("\n__Estimated Marginal Means for SOV:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov))
    
    cat("\n__Estimated Marginal Means for Cond:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond))
    
    cat("\n__Estimated Marginal Means for SOV x Condition interaction:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov * cond))
    
    # Add pairwise comparisons
    cat("\n__Pairwise comparisons for SOV:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov)))
    
    cat("\n__Pairwise comparisons for Cond:__\n")
    cat("____________________________________\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond)))
  }
}

# Function to save results
save_results <- function(results, component_name) {
  # Save plots to PDF
  pdf(paste0(component_name, "_plots.pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  grid.arrange(results$plots)
  dev.off()
  
  # Save text results to file
  sink(paste0(component_name, "_results.txt"))
  
  cat("\nResults for", component_name, ":\n")
  
  cat("\n__Model Comparisons:__\n")
  cat("\nNull vs Main Effects Model:\n")
  cat("\n____________________________________\n")
  print(results$null_vs_main)
  
  cat("\nMain Effects vs Interaction Model:\n")
  cat("\n____________________________________\n")
  print(results$main_vs_interaction)
  
  cat("\nNull vs Interaction Model:\n")
  cat("\n____________________________________\n")
  print(results$null_vs_interaction)
  
  if(!is.null(results$message)) {
    cat("\n", results$message, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\nMain effect of SOV:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(results$sov_effect)
    
    cat("\nMain effect of Condition:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(results$cond_effect)
    
    cat("\nInteraction model summary:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(results$interaction_model_summary)
    
    # Add emmeans results
    cat("\nEstimated Marginal Means for SOV:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov))
    
    cat("\nEstimated Marginal Means for Cond:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond))
    
    cat("\nEstimated Marginal Means for SOV x Condition interaction:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov * cond))
    
    cat("\nPairwise comparisons for SOV:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov)))
    
    cat("\nPairwise comparisons for Cond:\n")
    cat("\n____________________________________\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond)))
  }
  
  sink()
}


```

```{r}
N100_results <- analyze_component(N100_data, "N100")
P2_results <- analyze_component(P2_data, "P2")
N350_results <- analyze_component(N350_data, "N350")


print_results(N100_results)
print_results(P2_results)
print_results(N350_results)


# Save results for each component
save_results(N100_results, "N100")
save_results(P2_results, "P2")
save_results(N350_results, "N350")
```
